questions.prompt: Who was the longest-reigning monarch in British history?
questions.fact: She reigned for over 70 years, passing Victoria's record in 2015.

questions.prompt: What is the term for an animal that eats only plants?
questions.fact: They need long digestive systems or several stomachs, because the cellulose in plants is so hard to break down.

questions.prompt: Which cycling race is the most prestigious Grand Tour?
questions.fact: About 3,500 km over three weeks. The leader's yellow jersey matched the newsprint of the paper that founded the race.

questions.prompt: Which film series features the character Ellen Ripley?
questions.fact: Ripley was written without a specified gender, and casting a woman as the sole survivor broke the convention of the time.

questions.prompt: Which country has the longest coastline in the world?
questions.fact: Its coastline runs over 200,000 km, mostly around Arctic islands — longer than the next several countries put together.
